decisions.briefing: Markets are modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ +0.8% and S&P 500 +0.7%. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, we deployed into the three highest-scoring candidates showing full multi-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) while holding all existing positions steady.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices edged higher today, with NASDAQ gaining 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, a mild risk-on tone rather than a dramatic rally. The gains were fairly uniform across sectors rather than driven by one headline event. This kind of steady, modest advance often reflects continued investor confidence rather than a reaction to a single catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍溫和上揚，納指升0.8%，標普500亦上升0.7%，屬溫和的「風險偏好」格局，而非大幅飆升。升幅在各板塊間較為平均，並非由單一消息刺激所致。此類穩步向上的走勢，往往反映投資者信心持續，而非對個別新聞的即時反應。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking that a price move is backed by higher-than-usual trading volume, which suggests real institutional buying rather than a random blip. Today's buy candidates (RMBS, INIO, VSAT) all showed a volume surge alongside bullish RSI and MACD signals, giving more confidence the move is genuine.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「成交量確認」是指留意股價的升跌是否伴隨著高於平常的成交量，這代表可能有機構資金真正買入，而非偶然的短暫波動。今日選中的RMBS、INIO及VSAT均同時出現成交量激增、RSI及MACD的利好訊號，令人更有信心這是真實的上升動力。
